# `csharp_space_around_declaration_statements`

Extra spaces in declaration statements. false normalises; ignore leaves them alone.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `false` |  |
| `ignore` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Example

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run()
    {
        int  x=1;
        string  name="curb";
        bool  active=true;
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run()
    {
        int x = 1;
        string name = "curb";
        bool active = true;
    }
}
```
:::

::::

### `csharp_space_around_declaration_statements = ignore`

```ini
csharp_space_around_declaration_statements = ignore
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run()
    {
        int  x=1;
        string  name="curb";
        bool  active=true;
    }
}
```
